heart.name: Heart
heart.bio: The heart itself can be infected. Staph on the valves (endocarditis), Lyme carditis, viral myocarditis. Germs only passing through the bloodstream do NOT infect it; only germs that target heart tissue do.

lungs.name: Lungs
lungs.bio: Damaged lungs mean poor gas exchange. The whole body weakens.

liver.name: Liver
liver.effect: Antibody storage capped at 2 per class
liver.bio: The liver makes many defence proteins; damage it and antibody supply falls.

marrow.name: Bone Marrow
marrow.bio: All immune cells are made in the marrow.

brain.name: Brain
brain.effect: None. But fragile & slow to defend
brain.bio: Immune privilege: the blood-brain barrier keeps immune cells out, so it is hard to defend and cannot take much damage.

spleen.name: Spleen
spleen.bio: The spleen filters encapsulated bacteria from the blood. Without it, bacterial infection runs wild.

kidneys.name: Kidneys
kidneys.bio: Damaged kidneys leak antibodies into the urine. A real cause of secondary immunodeficiency.
